backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Article/UserProfile types, CRUD operations, publish/unpublish logic, admin registration, blob storage mixin, and access control for the FX Colonel backend.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the fix for the frontend publish/toggle-publish action, listing affected files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component, hook, page, and utility's purpose and key changes made.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/components/utilities entry with OKLCH CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes including sidebar, chart, and destructive color variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the FX Colonel Vite app, loading DM Sans and DM Serif Display Google Fonts and mounting the React app via /src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component using TanStack Router with a Layout shell (Header, Footer, Toaster) and routes for LandingPage, AdminDashboard, and ApiReferencePage.
frontend/src/components/ArticleCard.tsx: Article card component that renders cover image (calling `.getDirectURL()` on ExternalBlob), keywords, title, excerpt, and meta with hover animations and optional draft badge.
frontend/src/components/ArticleDetailMod: Responsive article detail modal with bottom-sheet mobile behavior, touch-swipe-to-close, sanitized HTML body rendering, and cover image via `.getDirectURL()` on ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/ArticleEditor.ts: A rich-text article editor component supporting title, slug, author, content (via ReactQuill), SEO keywords, cover image, and additional inline images with upload progress, draft/publish saving, and copy-to-clipboard for image URLs.
Displays a searchable, filterable list of articles with stats (total/published/drafts) and per-article actions for editing, toggling publish status, and deleting, with inline success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmationModa: An animated modal dialog that prompts the user to confirm a destructive action, showing a title, message, cancel button, and a configurable confirm button with a loading state.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer component rendering brand info, navigation links, a trading disclaimer, copyright year, and a 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky site header with brand name, desktop and mobile navigation links (including a conditional admin Dashboard link), and an Internet Identity login/logout button with loading state.
frontend/src/components/HeroImageSetting: Admin settings panel for updating the site's hero image, supporting both direct URL input and file upload (converted to a data URL), with a live preview and success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new authenticated users to enter their name, then saves the profile via the `useSaveCallerUserProfile` mutation with animated open/close transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates all dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook that manage Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and persisting identity across page reloads via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the app, covering published articles, search, hero image, admin article management, admin checks, and user profile CRUD operations against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that defines the dark-themed design system using Tailwind CSS and OKLCH color tokens (gold/navy palette), plus custom styles for inputs, autofill, and the Quill rich-text editor.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrappers around the root `App` component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: The admin dashboard page that handles authentication gating, displays article stats, and provides views for listing articles, editing/creating articles, and managing the hero image, with a profile setup modal for new users.
frontend/src/pages/ApiReferencePage.tsx: Renders a static API reference page documenting backend canister endpoints with copyable code blocks, endpoint cards showing method signatures, and usage examples for both agent-based and HTTP query interfaces.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Main public-facing page displaying a hero section with a search bar and a paginated grid of published articles, supporting debounced search and article detail modal.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for stripping HTML, formatting bigint nanosecond timestamps to readable dates, truncating text, and computing relative date strings.
frontend/src/utils/slugify.ts: Exports a single `slugify` function that converts a string to a URL-friendly lowercase hyphenated slug.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL and hash query parameters, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom CSS-variable-based colors (gold, navy, charcoal), DM Sans/Serif fonts, border radii, gold glow shadows, and the animate and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking a known bug where publishing articles/drafts fails, with one pending backend fix request (AR-1) and one existing frontend fix feature targeting the publish mutation and query invalidation.
